description: Events generated by firewalls, Layer 3 switches, and managed switches: allowed or denied traffic, inter-VLAN policy violations, and network-device administrative changes. This schema defines the telemetry source shape only. Normalization, transport, correlation, and detection are handled downstream; an external SIEM performs correlation, detection, investigation, and alerting. The repository does not operate a SIEM.

action.description: Required. The enforcement decision taken on the traffic.

correlation_id.description: Optional. Opaque identifier for joining related events across sources.

destination.description: Required. Where the traffic or event was directed.

destination_port.description: Optional. Flat alias for destination.port, for pipelines that prefer top-level fields. Use one or the other, not both.

device_identity.description: Optional. Endpoint or device identity where known, for example a MAC address or Intune device ID.

event_type.description: Required. network_policy_violation covers denied traffic and ACL or firewall policy violations. network_policy_allow covers allowed traffic logged where operationally useful. device_config_change covers VLAN, trunk, or port configuration changes. admin_access covers administrative logins to network devices.

message.description: Required. Human-readable summary. Must not contain secrets, passwords, tokens, or private key material.

network_zone.description: Optional. Zone label used for correlation, for example AI_AUTOMATION.

policy_id.description: Optional. Identifier of the firewall rule or ACL ACE that made the decision, for example AI_TO_MGMT_DENY.

severity.description: Required. Severity assigned at the source. Downstream SIEM logic may re-prioritize.

source.description: Required. Where the traffic or event originated.

device.description: Optional. Device that generated the event, for example firewall.example.

zone.description: Optional. Source network zone, for example AI_AUTOMATION, MANAGEMENT, GUEST, CORPORATE.

timestamp.description: Required. RFC3339 UTC timestamp of when the event occurred, for example 2026-01-01T12:00:00Z.

user_identity.description: Optional. Human user associated with the traffic where the device can determine one. Never include passwords or tokens.

vlan.description: Optional. Source VLAN ID where known.

workload_identity.description: Optional. Non-human workload identity where known, for example an AI agent runner name.

title: Network policy event
